items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: I picked the phone up, I called, I said, “Kenny, this is Allan Gumbs.” “You want a gig?” “What?”

ctx.x: And then every time, because it was like a Brazilian tune, right. So I go back to school, so every time like a Latin guest, or a person from like Puerto Rico or Brazil or something, every time they introduced a guest like that, I remember Catarina Valente was one of the guests [scats] that’s my tune. So I was like grinning you know. So going back again, Dr. Taylor and Leroy Kirkland and the next person that had an effect on me was Kenny Burrell.
